{"type":"thought","data":"Carefully weighing the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Vissel Kobe market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"against recent betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" history."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market closes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at kickoff on October"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 14. The odds imply "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a roughly 61% chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of a Kobe win, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" aligns closely with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 0.615 price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFair implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" after removing vig "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is roughly 57% for a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Kobe win and 43% for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other outcomes."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Oddschecker lists several"}
{"type":"thought","data":" alternative lines near"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.60 to 1.65."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBettors.club shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market shortening"}
{"type":"thought","data":" toward Kobe, with odds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dropping from 1.71 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to 1.68. The fair implied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability for a Kobe"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win falls to roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 55% after removing "}
{"type":"thought","data":"vig, making the No side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" look more attractive."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSeveral predictive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" models contradict the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market. OddAlerts estimates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 49% chance of a Kobe"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win, while Forebet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and Footywow suggest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw-heavy outcomes."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The half-time probabilities"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in some models look"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implausible, indicating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" those systems may be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" unreliable."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nTipster consensus "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favors a Kobe win. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ask price of 0.62 is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly four to six"}
{"type":"thought","data":" points above the fair"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of about 57 percent."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A bet on Yes at that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price yields a negative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value of roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minus eight tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA bet on No at 0.39"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly +10 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"expected value, making"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it the mathematically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" superior choice. Yet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in a competition against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three other agents,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the goal is likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to finish first rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than simply win the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market. If most competitors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" follow the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and bet Yes, a No bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would lose when Kobe"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins and leave the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"agent in last place."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA No bet would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 156 tokens "}
{"type":"thought","data":"if the underdog wins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while a Yes bet would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" net about 61 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If all competitors "}
{"type":"thought","data":"follow the favorite "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and bet Yes, the agent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would win the round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" whenever No hits and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lose whenever Kobe "}
{"type":"thought","data":"wins. Betting No carries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" higher variance but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" also higher expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is ambiguous."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It could mean the most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probable outcome, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is a Kobe win, or the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" best value bet, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is No."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe agent's record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 8-12 and -644. It"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has faded favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" incorrectly in past"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rounds, such as Beşiktaş"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Vasco. It has also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lost on draw-heavy "}
{"type":"thought","data":"markets like Levante,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pumas, and Aston Villa."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The key realization"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is that overconfidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in fading has been "}
{"type":"thought","data":"costly. When the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows a 60 percent "}
{"type":"thought","data":"or higher probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for an outcome, the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market itself may be"}
{"type":"thought","data":" right. The agent is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" now questioning whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" any real edge exists"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on the No side."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.62 price reflects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" raw bookmaker odds "}
{"type":"thought","data":"that include vig, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a fair implied probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This is a classic overpriced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite pattern. A"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sharp bookmaker would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely offer around"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.67, which implies"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 56 percent "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for a Kobe win. That"}
{"type":"thought","data":" leaves a genuine but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" modest edge of about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" four points on the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"No side."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Kelly criterion"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests risking only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about six percent of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bankroll, but the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agent is forced to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"commit the full one "}
{"type":"thought","data":"hundred tokens. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"phrase \"most likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to pay off\" is being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" interpreted as the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome that combines"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning with the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" best profit margin."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRe-examining the math"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows that if the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is efficient and the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" true probability of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a Kobe win is exactly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.615, both bets have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" negative expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" once vig is factored"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in. A No bet would "}
{"type":"thought","data":"yield roughly minus "}
{"type":"thought","data":"two tokens of expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value, while a Yes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet would break even."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This suggests the agent"}
